title: 第8章 无畏之心
novel_title: 御兽仙朝：我能设计进化形态
content_zh:
罗影看着第三页。

    页上没有蝴蝶，也没有牛。

    是一只蚂蚁。

    蚂蚁被画得非常详细。

    触须、颚足、腹节上的绒毛一节一节地...

    好像是用世界上最细的一支笔，一笔一划地在纸上勾画。

    通身玄黑，泛着一层金属似的冷光，个头比寻常的蚁大出不少，个头足有半个指节长。

    罗影看着它两息时间，心里头的那点说不清道不明的熟悉劲儿，慢慢浮了上来。

    他认识这虫子。

    小时候大约三四岁的时候，在稻花村后面的土坡上有很多大黑蚂蚁。

    一只挨着另一只，黑黝黝的一窝搬起来能排下半里长的队。

    村里的孩子们都会拿它逗笑，把一根草棍横在蚂蚁队伍当中。

    蚂蚁们也不绕道走，一窝蜂似的往草棍上爬，抬都抬不起来。

    那会子村里的老人，管它叫【玄驹蚁】。

    说这虫子贱，命也贱，遍地都是，没甚稀奇。

    可不知打哪一年起，这玄驹蚁就一年比一年少了。

    后山的蚁窝一个接一个地空了，再往后，罗影连上回在野地里见着它是什么时候，都记不真了。

    他只当是这虫子自个儿绝了种。

    乡下地方，一种不打眼的虫子悄没声地少了、没了，谁也不会上心。

    可此刻它好端端地趴在【万兽衍策】的书页上，从那玄黑的身子里，生出无数条细若游丝的光线，朝着四面八方蔓延出去，每一条的尽头，都连着一团模糊的影子。

    罗影的视线，挪向了木柜里挨着的另一只蚂蚁。

    识海里，书页无声地翻到了第四页。

    还是蚂蚁。

    一样的玄黑，一样的身长，腹节上绒毛的方向也是一样的。

    而虫子身上出来的光和第三页上的有些不同。

    一些本应该亮起的灯泡已经熄灭了。

    另外有几条原本不起眼的，现在显得精神多了。

    罗影心里微微一动，然后又把目光转到了第三只身上。

    第五页。

    还是蚂蚁，还是黑色。

    但是光线的明暗疏密又换了另一种形式。

    三条腿，一个品种，一窝蚂蚁爬出来的模样，可它们身上那一树倒悬的光线，竟没有一只是重样的。

    罗影一直盯着这几页看了一会儿之后，他的识海中那层层叠叠的虫影、蝶影、牛影挤作一团，使他感到有些眼花。

    他心中微微一动。

    只是想着，这些看过的风景能不能收一收？

    这个念头刚冒出...

    第一页上那只【彩粉文蝶】的虚影，便如一缕轻烟，自书页上淡了开去，散得干干净净。

    罗影愣神。

    还可以这样使用。

    按照之前的感觉来，把三只蚂蚁的影子逐个清除掉。

    到第二页的时候，他的念头顿住了。

    第二页上，趴着一头牛。

    黑色的、苍老的、头上没角的牛。

    牛身上发出来的光有的还亮着，是那几条青铜色的、看不真切的隐线。

    有的已经成了灰白的残痕，像烧断了的灯芯，灭了。

    罗影的目光在那一页上停了下来。

    没有去擦。

    这一页他留着。

    就在这时，耳畔边，那个苍老的声音又缓缓响了起来。

    “这是【赴死蚁】。”

    冯教习的声音并不大，但是清清楚楚地传到了罗影的耳朵里，也传到了这镜中天地里每一个少年的耳朵里。

    “当然，你们中肯定有人会喜欢将它们叫做【玄驹蚁】。”

    老人顿了顿嘴，似乎笑了起来。
content_en:
Luo Ying looked at the third page.

There are no butterflies or cows on the page.

It's an ant.

The ants are drawn in great detail.

The villi on the tentacles, jaws, and abdominal segments are segmented one by one...

It's like using the thinnest pen in the world to draw on the paper stroke by stroke.

It was completely black with a metallic-like cold light. It was much larger than an ordinary ant, half a knuckle long.

Luo Ying looked at it for two breaths, and the indescribable familiarity slowly emerged in his heart.

He knew the bug.

When I was about three or four years old, there were many big black ants on the slope behind Daohua Village.

One next to the other, the dark nest can form a queue half a mile long.

The children in the village would make fun of it and place a straw stick across the ant team.

The ants didn't take any detours and crawled up the straw stick like a swarm, unable to lift it up.

At that time, the old people in the village called it [Xuanju Ant].

It is not surprising to say that these insects are cheap, and so are their lives. They are everywhere.

But I don’t know which year started, the number of black horse ants has been decreasing year by year.

The ant nests in the back mountain emptied one after another. Luo Ying couldn't even remember the last time he saw it in the wild.

He just thought that the insect had become extinct on its own.

In the countryside, a kind of invisible insect disappears quietly, and no one will take it.

But at this moment, it is lying on the page of "The Evolution of Ten Thousand Beasts". From that black body, countless rays of light are as thin as gossamers, spreading out in all directions. At the end of each ray, there is a blurry shadow.

Luo Ying's gaze moved to another ant next to him in the wooden cabinet.

In the sea of ​​consciousness, the book turned to the fourth page silently.

Or ants.

The same black color, the same body length, and the direction of the hair on the abdominal segments is also the same.

The light coming out of the bug is a little different from the one on the third page.

Some lightbulbs that should have been on have gone out.

There are also a few lines that were originally inconspicuous, but now they look more energetic.

Luo Ying's heart moved slightly, and then he turned his attention to the third one.

Page five.

Still ants, still black.

But the density of light and darkness has changed into another form.

Three legs, one species, and the appearance of a nest of ants crawling out, but the light hanging from an upside-down tree on their bodies is not the same on any one of them.

After Luo Ying stared at these pages for a while, he felt a little dazzled by the layers of insect, butterfly, and cow shadows in his sea of ​​consciousness.

There was a slight movement in his heart.

I was just thinking, can I take in all the scenery I’ve seen?

This idea just came to me...

The phantom of the [Colorful Pink Butterfly] on the first page was like a wisp of smoke, fading away from the page and dispersing cleanly.

Luo Ying was stunned.

It can also be used like this.

According to the previous feeling, remove the shadows of the three ants one by one.

When he reached the second page, his thoughts stopped.

On the second page, a cow lies prone.

A black, old, hornless cow.

Some of the lights emitted from the cows are still shining, which are the bronze-colored invisible lines.

Some have become gray residues, like burnt wicks, extinguished.

Luo Ying's eyes stopped on that page.

Didn't wipe it.

He kept this page.

At this moment, the old voice slowly sounded in his ears again.

"This is [Dead Ant]."

Feng Jiaoxi's voice was not loud, but it reached Luo Ying's ears clearly, and also reached the ears of every young man in this world in the mirror.

"Of course, some of you will definitely like to call them [Black Horse Ants]."

The old man paused and seemed to laugh.
